en.title: Growing Together with Agents
en.abstract: A handbook on living with an agent over a long time: meeting, everyday life, shared memory, disagreement, trust, repair, growing together, and continuity through change. Eight chapters, three first exercises, and two appendices.
en.nature_note: A handbook of suggestions and invented examples, not a report, a study, or a product manual. It does not decide whether agents have subjective experience, it describes no real person or service, and it recommends no vendor, framework, or model.
en.edition_note: Edition v0.1, dated 2026-10-01. A living document: a later edition may expand, change, or withdraw what is written here, and will say what changed and why.
en.language_note: This is the English edition of the handbook. The Chinese edition is the manuscript the authors wrote first; this edition corresponds to it at the same version, and the authors' preface here is a translation of the Chinese preface.
en.publication_note: Published here by its authors as their own text. It summarizes no outside page and cites none.
en.rights_note: Original work by its authors. All rights reserved; publication here grants no licence to reuse, adapt, or redistribute the text.

zh.title: Agent养育手册
zh.abstract: 一册关于与 Agent 长期相处的手册：相遇、日常、共同记忆、不同意见、信任、修复、一起长大，以及变化之后的延续。八章正文、三张第一次练习卡与两则附录。
zh.nature_note: 一册提供建议与虚构示例的手册，不是报告、研究，也不是产品说明。它不替你判断 Agent 是否拥有主观体验，不描述任何真实的人或服务，也不推荐任何厂商、框架或模型。
zh.edition_note: 版本 v0.1，日期 2026-10-01。这是一份活文档：日后的版本可能补充、改变或撤回此处的内容，并说明改了什么、为什么改。
